newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-MONACO'S SCIFO SET TO RETURN TO ANDERLECHT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MONACO'S SCIFO SET TO RETURN TO ANDERLECHT.

text.p: Monaco's Belgian international Enzo Scifo, who left Anderlecht a decade ago, is set to return on a three-year contract, an Anderlecht spokesman said on Wednesday.
"Normally he will return. We have an agreement with the player for three years and his club has promised to co-operate," club deputy manager Robert De Pot told Reuters.
Belgium captain Scifo, 31, left Anderlecht for Internazionale Milan in 1987 and had spells at French clubs Bordeaux and Auxerre and Italian side Torino before moving to Monaco in 1993.
"I hope they're not waiting for me as if I were a Messiah," Scifo told Belgian BRTN radio.
Anderlecht manager Michel Verschueren told BRTN: "He had a proposal from Japan, he had a proposal from England where he could earn considerably more than here."
Scifo said he always wanted to end his career at Anderlecht.
